title: WAL savepoint capture

scope.rationale: sqlite3WalSavepoint captures the current maximum frame, two frame-checksum words, and checkpoint sequence into the four-word state consumed by WAL savepoint rollback.

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete four-word capture body is assigned and uses the existing savepointUndo representation.

inputs: Borrowed Wal with write lock held
outputs: Four u32 words: max frame, checksum word 0, checksum word 1, checkpoint sequence
contracts.ownership: Returns a value array; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Field order and values are exact.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Asserts write lock; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No runtime failure path under precondition.

representation_differences: Zig returns [4]u32 by value instead of writing through a caller pointer.

oracle.protocol: Seed max frame 2, checksum {11,12}, checkpoint sequence 4 under write lock and compare exact array.
oracle.normalization: Array order and u32 values are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller write lock external.
assurance.malformed_input: Missing write lock violates asserted precondition.

integration.native_call_path: Capture representation feeds the existing savepointUndo shape in the unit trace; transaction savepoint callers remain pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires transaction savepoint integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/wal_core.zig Header, checkpoint_sequence, savepointUndo, and tests were reviewed
callers: Unit trace captures and then prepares rollback state
assertions_branches_cleanup: The generated write-lock assertion and all four assignments are assigned
No branch, allocation, mutation, or cleanup
upstream_tests: Upstream WAL savepoint rollback tests cover capture
Project trace compares exact four-word state
